title: quorum — a rank, not a count and not a fraction
subtitle: {model.params} parameters · {model.input_shape} in, {node:n0187.out_shape} out

stages.name: score each cell against its own rate
detail: a busy cell's onset is worth less
stages.note: A long box filter gives each cell its own occupancy; minus its log, applied where that cell fired, is the surprise. The width is a configuration value, fixed across a screen. This is the only place in the estate where per-cell rate heterogeneity reaches the arithmetic.

stages.name: sort the cells
stages.note: An order statistic over the CELL axis. The censored surround the tube screen left out was one over the TIME axis, where it costs a sliding window; here it is one sort per frame.

stages.name: a soft quorum at m
stages.note: Both free parameters live here, and the only thing this stage reads from the recording is HOW MANY CELLS it has — a shape, not a tensor, which is why no edge reaches it. The exponent is clamped to the two rules it interpolates, so a fitted value at either bound is the model saying one of them was right after all.

stages.name: the quorum's surprise
detail: weighted mean over the deepest cells

stages.name: the whole field's surprise
stages.note: The contrast channel. A quorum that is loud only because the whole field is loud is not coordination, and the head needs both numbers to tell the difference.

constants.n0030.constants.kernel_size: Architectural. `occupancy_frames` is a configuration value on the builder, fixed for a screen, and no gradient reaches it.
